evidence.quote: All Team Members are required to request an approval to relocate prior to moving. Moving to a new location is an exciting adventure, and at GitLab, we want to encourage team members to utilize the flexibility that our relocation policy offers. However, there are multiple aspects to consider including eligibility, possible impact on compensation (including equity and benefit eligibility) and the impact on your role at GitLab. The consequences of not communicating to the appropriate group could result in disciplinary action up to and including termination, depending on the circumstances. Having team members working outside of their contractual location poses potential tax liability for both GitLab and the team member. For this reason, it is important to communicate transparently and promptly with your manager and with the People Team.

A relocation that results in no change in compensation can be approved by the team member’s direct manager. Relocations resulting in an increase in compensation must be approved by the team member’s direct manager, and location factor changes that are >.2 will require direct manager, VP as well as an e-group Member approval.
